limits: Same file targets, coordinates and source data; one sequential diagnostic capture per served version/project, with automation, tracing and 1 ms CPU sampling. This is not a field percentile or a controlled exclusive-stage experiment.
No getHostSibling sample means unavailable at this sampling resolution, never zero execution time. Whole CPU-profile phase intervals include instrumentation boundaries.
Area batches hold at most 128 original siblings; the number of batches, reference and declaration lists can still grow. No universal linear-time React/rendering claim.
Handler dispatch is inclusive synchronous time; two-rAF and frame intervals are proxies, not physical presentation or field INP. API timings and CPU stages overlap.
The current five-visit navigation comparison uses the immediately prior identical-baseline-assets capture; it is not an interleaved startup benchmark. Native/project/OS caches are warm.
Fixture TUI/GUI checks use actual offline workers and installed tools with scripted inference; they do not validate actual model quality, cold installation, local inference or confidentiality.
